description: Latest price for one dairy product, from USDA MARS weekly dairy reports — the same series get_dairy_history extends over time. Use for a current quote; use get_dairy_history instead for the weekly trend. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Prices are in US dollars per pound (USD/lb); the result's `unit` field states the exact unit for the product. Geography defaults to US-Central (cheese is Oceania cheddar and defaults to geography 'Oceania'). Butter is deliberately withheld: USDA publishes only price differentials for butter, no US base price, so butter returns a withheld notice instead of a misleading value.

geography.description: Report region (US-Central, US-East, US-West; cheese uses US). Default: US-Central

product.description: Dairy product (cheese, butter, dry_whey, fluid_milk). Butter prices are withheld — see description

name: get_dairy_price
